UI_AnimalBalance_HeavyPickup: This animal weighs %1 kg, above the safe pickup limit of %2 kg.
UI_ChilaSeda_AnimalBalance_PredationDesc: Set how many zombies can pursue each animal and how long they wait before abandoning or ignoring unreachable prey. Covers normal animal prey and species added by Undead Wildlife.
UI_ChilaSeda_AnimalBalance_MaxHuntersToo: Maximum zombies allowed to pursue the same animal. Range: 1 to 20.
UI_ChilaSeda_AnimalBalance_StallTimeout: Seconds without getting closer before giving up
UI_ChilaSeda_AnimalBalance_StallTimeoutT: The timer resets when a zombie gets at least 0.35 tiles closer. Range: 5 to 300 seconds.
UI_ChilaSeda_AnimalBalance_UnreachablePr: Seconds to ignore an unreachable animal
The animal becomes eligible sooner if it moves 2 tiles or changes level. Set to 0 to disable this pause. Range: 0 to 600 seconds.
